title: Microsoft Purview: row-level counting of exact data match (EDM) matches
summary: Hold: the route to the counting control skips a required choice of schema-creation method in the wizard. The counting descriptions, licensing and roadmap facts are supported, but the assurances that no new data is read and that rule actions do not change go beyond Microsoft's published description.

claims.quote: Providing a new mode to count EDM Matches where each row is counted once in addition to the current behavior where each primary element is counted once

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; controls[0].governs
claims.claim: Primary Match-level Counting counts each matching combination of primary and supporting elements separately, even within the same row.
claims.quote: Primary Match-level Counting: Counts each matching combination of primary and supporting elements separately—even within the same row.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure; controls[0].governs
claims.claim: Row-level Counting counts each row once even if multiple elements in it match.
claims.quote: Row-level Counting: Counts each row only once, even if multiple elements match in it.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Learn advises primary match-level counting for a detailed view of all matches and row-level counting for the number of sensitive records.
claims.quote: Choose this if you want a detailed view of all sensitive matches. ... Use this when you care about how many unique records (rows) are sensitive, not how many elements matched.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; What's changing; Why it matters; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated the default counting mode or what this control does on arrival.
claims.quote: Searched: EDM unique counting mode row-level counting default existing sensitive information types change. Opened the new-experience schema/rule-package page and EDM overview; counting choices are described without a default. The roadmap states no default.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Open questions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: No source states whether existing EDM SITs change automatically.
claims.quote: Searched: EDM unique counting mode row-level counting default existing sensitive information types change. Opened the new-experience creation page, EDM overview and classic rule-package page; none states automatic migration of existing SITs.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The printed route goes directly from + Create EDM classifier to Configure detection rules for primary elements and unique counting mode.
claims.quote: Select the method you want to use for your schema: either Upload a file containing sample data, or Manually define your data structure. ... On the Select primary elements page ... Configure settings for data in selected columns.
claims.fix: Replace controls[0].ui.path and its rendered route with 'Data classification > EDM classifiers > + Create EDM classifier > Upload a file containing sample data > Upload file > Select primary elements > Configure settings for data in selected columns > Configure detection rules for primary elements > unique counting mode'. Keep the note that New EDM experience must be On, and add 'This route uses the sample-file method.' The cited creation page gives this branch; the current route omits the required schema-method choice.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented a PowerShell or API operation that sets this counting mode.
claims.quote: Searched: EDM unique counting row-level counting PowerShell XML ExactMatch counting mode Set-DlpSensitiveInformationTypeRulePackage; EDM row-level Graph API counting. Read classic EDM rule-package, custom SIT XML and Set-DlpSensitiveInformationTypeRulePackage references; no mode setting.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope: Roles; Governance controls
claims.claim: The creation page requires Compliance administrator or Global administrator to create, test and deploy a custom EDM SIT in the portal.
claims.quote: To create, test, and deploy a custom sensitive information type (which an EDM SIT is) in the Microsoft Purview portal, use an account that is in one of these roles: Compliance administrator; Global administrator.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance
claims.claim: DLP and auto-labelling rules using EDM can require multiple matches, so counts can affect whether their conditions are met.
claims.quote: DLP or auto-labeling rules that require multiple matches don't trigger ... Make sure that the proximity requirements for both your EDM SIT and the base SITs are met.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/sit-get-started-exact-data-match-test to sources for the statements about EDM match-count conditions in DLP and auto-labelling rules.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The counting option reads no new data.
claims.quote: Searched: EDM row-level counting data access permissions actions no new data; exact data match counting data permissions actions. Read the new-experience creation page and EDM overview; neither states unchanged data access for this mode.
claims.fix: Remove 'No new data is read.' from Data exposure and ', and it reads no new data' from the risk rationale. Retain the supported description of how row-level counting counts matches.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: The counting mode does not change the actions that consuming rules take.
claims.quote: Searched: exact data match counting data permissions actions. Read the new-experience creation page and EDM overview; they describe counting and supported consumers, not an assurance that consuming-rule actions remain unchanged.
claims.fix: Replace 'The counting mode changes the number those rules see, not the action they take.' with 'The counting mode changes how EDM matches are counted.'

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: No identity or permission change specific to this counting option is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: exact data match counting data permissions actions. Opened the new-experience creation page, EDM overview and notifications page; none documents a new identity or permission requirement for the counting option.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Scope: Limits
claims.claim: Schemas created in the classic experience or uploaded as XML through PowerShell are not viewable or manageable in the new experience.
claims.quote: All schemas that are created using the classic experience or uploaded as an XML file using PowerShell aren't viewable or manageable in the new experience.

claims.where: Scope: Limits
claims.claim: The new experience creates one schema for each EDM SIT.
claims.quote: Each time you create an EDM SIT using the new experience, a new schema is created. This results in a 1:1 mapping between EDM schema and EDM SIT.

claims.where: Scope: Limits
claims.claim: The new experience is limited to creating and managing 10 EDM SITs.
claims.quote: Because the new experience doesn't support mapping multiple SITs to the same schema, you're limited to creating and managing 10 EDM SITs.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: The two counting modes can yield different match totals for the same content.
claims.quote: Primary Match-level Counting: Counts each matching combination ... separately—even within the same row. ... Row-level Counting: Counts each row only once, even if multiple elements match in it.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout and After rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The checklist tells readers to record and revisit rule instance-count thresholds, but these controls have no table row.
claims.quote: Record the instance-count thresholds on those rules ... Revisit rule thresholds ... Controls table: Unique counting mode (primary match-level or row-level) of an EDM SIT.
claims.fix: Remove 'Record the instance-count thresholds on those rules so you can compare them with row-level counts.' and 'Revisit rule thresholds if row-level counts fall below the numbers the rules expect.' from the governance checklist, or narrow those steps to comparing classifier match counts. The threshold controls have no row; do not add rows as part of this correction.
